spans.s: मियक्ष् मियक्ष्. See म्यक्ष्, p. 800, col. 1.

मियेध मियेध, अस्, m. food set before the
gods, a sacrificial meal or oblation, (perhaps) = मेध,
a sacrificial animal or victim, (according to Sāy. de-
rived fr. मेध; cf. Zend myazda.)

मियेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, partaking of or receiving
the sacrificial food, worthy of the oblation; (Sāy. =
मेधस्य यज्ञस्य योग्य or यज्ञार्ह.)
